idea-plugin.name: SailPoint Identity Security Cloud
idea-plugin.description:
Work with SailPoint Identity Security Cloud from the IDE.
  • Connect to any number of tenants and browse their sources, transforms, connector rules and identities in the SailPoint tool window
  • Edit transforms as JSON with schema-based completion and validation, then push them back to your tenant
  • Edit sources and their schemas, provisioning policies, aggregation schedules, correlation config, attribute sync, native change detection and deletion approvals as JSON and push them back to your tenant
  • Edit connector rule scripts and push them back to your tenant
Add tenants from the tool window or under Settings | Tools | SailPoint ISC. Each tenant uses its own Personal Access Token.
